about: Vetted AI providers for the free-trial chain (owner decision AI-D19). Read by genai/vetted.py; people read docs/compliance/AI_PROVIDER_REGISTER.md. A new or changed row is a Major AI change. An upstream may answer only when commercial_use is true, trains_on_data is 'no' or 'opt_out_confirmed', and date_checked is under 12 months old (a warning from 6 months). Rows with nulls are not vetted yet: the owner fills them after reading each provider's terms. A 'models' list is an allowlist of the upstream's model ids: an empty list lets no model answer (OpenRouter: the owner adds each free model after testing it).

providers.terms_link: self-hosted open-source software (no provider terms; loopback only)
providers.notes: Self-hosted router, bound to 127.0.0.1. Only vetted upstream keys are entered in it; its key for MDARIX is scoped to vetted models. Upstream names in X-Routed-Via: groq, cloudflare, openrouter.

providers.terms_link: self-hosted open-source software (no provider terms; loopback only)
providers.notes: Self-hosted gateway; only vetted upstreams in its combo. Reply format read from its published source (release v3.8.52, 19 Oct 2026; no v3.8.54 exists), never by calling it: the provider alias is in X-OmniRoute-Provider and the model in X-OmniRoute-Model; the body 'model' is the bare upstream model name (or the requested name when its echo setting is on); a cached reply says X-OmniRoute-Cache: HIT and is discarded. Register rows for its upstreams use OmniRoute's provider aliases (groq, cloudflare-ai).

Called directly as the last provider of the trial chain, and behind OmniRoute. Services Agreement (last modified 22 Jun 2026): 'Groq is not permitted to use Inputs or Outputs for training'. Data: https://console.groq.com/docs/your-data

Cloudflare Workers AI behind FreeLLMAPI (FreeLLMAPI's name). 'Cloudflare does not use Customer Content processed by Workers AI to train AI models.' Data: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/
The same Cloudflare Workers AI behind OmniRoute (OmniRoute's provider alias); same terms as the 'cloudflare' row.

Behind FreeLLMAPI only. Usable only with the account's privacy setting that blocks providers which train on data (owner set it before creating the key). Data: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging
